name: Nanagaki Alice
source:
A happy-go-lucky young girl. She's a straight-A student who has many friends, with a humble side that doesn't let it go to her head.

Like [url=/c24086]Yuuki[/url], she's a second-year student and his classmate.

[Based on the [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/dasaku/character02.html]official description[/url]]
